title: Frankfurter Bao
description: A delightful fusion of German and Filipino cuisine, featuring a crispy bao wrapped around a juicy Frankfurter.

ingredients.name: Pork Bao Dough
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores or made from scratch

instructions: Brush pork bao dough with pork fat or oil and grill for 2-3 minutes per side, until crispy.
Grill Frankfurter to 160°F (71°C) for food safety.
Slice cucumber and carrot into thin slices.
Assemble bao by placing a Frankfurter inside each piece of dough.
Top with cucumber, carrot, and chili sauce.
Garnish with sesame seeds, if desired.
